replay.opening_decision: On the same swarm seed, the original chose LOOT at +4.42. The patch chose KITE immediately at +10.16, with LOOT at -3.58.

controller_changes.threat: Inside the current circle, sound_threat >= 0.8 or a visible mech with enemy_close >= 0.5 selects KITE before mode hysteresis. Read obs.sounds once per decision, using sound events only when that field is absent.
controller_changes.kite: Sum all visible mech bearings weighted by 1/(1 + distance/60) and recent sound bearings weighted by distance and age. Face the sum. Move away with a 0.45 lateral component. If bearings cancel, use the strongest source.
controller_changes.loot: With only the starter gun, an empty slot, no visible enemy and sound_threat < 0.4, select an in-range weapon first, then the nearest visible weapon inside the circle. Prioritize it over cubes, NPCs and drops. Send its exact ID in take when within pickup_radius horizontally and 4 m vertically.
controller_changes.zone: Urgency uses zone.center and zone.radius. Outside the circle, select ROTATE. Under threat, steer inward while strafing and facing the combined threat.

validation: Raw KITE won all 50,736 tested in-zone threat inputs before the controller override. The smallest tested lead was 0.428. Controller tests also verified weapon selection over a closer cube, the take command, combined-threat facing and inward escape.

telemetry_targets.comparison: Compare slot 0 across the same 96 seeds with opponent controllers and weights frozen. The measured replay above covers one seed.
telemetry_targets.reaction: For sound-only and close-visible threat onsets separately, require 100% same-decision KITE inside the circle, including at full HP. Require zero LOOT decisions while either threat is active.
telemetry_targets.movement: On unobstructed KITE decisions away from the circle boundary and without a projectile dodge, require move dot threat_direction < 0, lateral-to-retreat ratio 0.45, and commanded yaw within 1 degree of the threat bearing. Measure actual rear hits divided by incoming weapon hits.
telemetry_targets.pickup: On safe starter decisions with an eligible weapon, require 100% LOOT with that weapon as the goal. When in range, require take to equal its ID. Count confirmed acquisitions from inventory and target more than 0.19 weapons per match.
telemetry_targets.outcomes: Target mean survival above 28.1 s, gun damage taken below 1291 per match, storm damage at or below 34.5 per match, and mean points above 4.125.
